about: The ten bursts at their fullest (300 ms). Each box: x, y, z of its lower-left-back corner in metres from the bomb's spot on the ground, then width, height, depth, colour key, gives light. One cube is 0.025 m, the tiny cube of every item (ITEMS_REMODEL.md). In the Trading Post a burst stands over its stand with its positions drawn in to 42% toward its middle (0.6 m up) and its pieces at full size.

confetti.name: Confetti
confetti.move: Thrown up in a fan, then each slab tumbles end over end and flutters down

snowfall.name: Snowfall
snowfall.move: Flakes puff out in a ring, hang for a beat, then drift down swaying 0.1 m side to side

hay.name: Hay
hay.move: Straws kick out low and wide, like a bale burst, spin once and settle

lantern.name: Lantern Glow
lantern.move: Paper lanterns lift off slowly, rise 1.6 m with a slow sway and fade at the top

frost.name: Frost
frost.move: Ice needles shoot out and stop dead, a frozen star, hold 300 ms, then snap into chips that drop

northern.name: Northern Lights
northern.move: Three curtains of light rise from the spot and ripple left to right, then thin out upward

starlight.name: Starlight
starlight.move: Stars shoot up, hang and twinkle twice, then fall as shooting stars with three-cell tails

ember.name: Ember
ember.move: Sparks fountain up with tails, arc over and die out one by one

bubblegum.name: Bubblegum
bubblegum.move: Three bubbles swell, wobble, and pop one after another into four bits each

solstice.name: Solstice
solstice.move: A small sun rises 0.8 m and its twelve rays push outward once, like a breath
